pairs.why: Both share the same clean rendering, but A's dome fills the frame as a bold, close hero object like the lighthouse and pool bar, while B sits small and distant in a wide landscape.
A has the full sculpted volume, soft sheen and clear light and shadow of the jacket and submarine, while B is flatter, slightly textured and has a strange pale rim on the brim.
The two are almost identical, and B's rope strands read a touch softer and smoother, which is the way the lessons lean.
B's rope is smoother, with subtle strands and a clean soft shadow, close to the finish of the scarf and fan, while A's sharp twisted texture is the too-textured look the lessons rejected.
B's chunky, smooth coils with a soft cast shadow match the real cards' finish better than A's busy, finely twisted strands.
A's thick, rounded coil with a softened twist pattern and bold shapes reads like a game asset, while B is the thin, high-texture lasso the lessons marked as too texture-y.
B's smoother rope and clean knot match the real cards' finish (smooth but not plastic), while A carries the rejected sharp strand texture.
B's smooth, chunky coils with a soft grounding shadow are closer to the scarf and spyglass than A's finely textured rope.
